reason: Document history rows: July 15, 2025 row states ECS supports native blue/green deployments to validate new service revisions before directing production traffic; November 27, 2018 row states ECS added blue/green deployments using CodeDeploy.

Under the Capacity provider strategy heading of the service definition parameters page, the quote states the base value designates how many tasks, at a minimum, to run on the specified capacity provider.

Quotes carry GetResources supporting all resource types, the IAM users and roles exception, the Auto Scaling groups empty-response exception, the Region and account scope of GetResources, task definition tags at registration, and the AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition row with Yes for Tag Editor tagging and tag-based groups.

On the task execution IAM role page, quote 1 states the role grants the ECS container and Fargate agents permission to make AWS API calls on your behalf; quote 2 states these permissions are not directly accessible by the containers in the task.

On the Fargate task retirement page, quote 1 states no action is needed for service tasks because the ECS scheduler replaces them; quote 2 states AWS stops standalone tasks on or after the retirement date and ECS does not launch a replacement.
